newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heinz cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heinz cut to hold.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg said on Wednesday it had cut its rating for H.J. Heinz Co to hold from buy.
-- Analyst Chris Jakubik wrote in a report that he also cut the 12-month price target for the company's stock to $38 from $41.
-- The second quarter earnings per share of $0.47 "outpaces consensus of $0.46, our own $0.45," Jakubik wrote.

-- "Concerns over Weight Control division's volume growth prospects and the pace of working capital reductions for the benefit of deleveraging/EPS growth to likely outweigh positives of Heinz story in the near term.
-- "With such issues outstanding ... upward revaluation of HNZ shares we had been advocating is unlikely."
-- The company's shares opened down 3/8 to 35-3/4.
